author: NorthEast News Desk
body: The Rhode Island Lottery has launched Powerball Xs & Os, a football-themed draw game that uses NFL team logos rather than game scores.

Players choose eight logos from the league’s 32 teams. Eight winning logos will be drawn at random each Sunday at 10 p.m. beginning September 13. Matching at least four can produce a cash prize, while matching all eight wins a rolling jackpot that starts at $1 million.

The lottery emphasized that results are random and have no connection to NFL game outcomes. Tickets cost $5 and are available from Rhode Island Lottery retailers, RILot.com and the lottery’s mobile app.

Tickets can also generate entries for separate promotional drawings that may offer NFL merchandise, experiences or a Super Bowl trip. Those promotions do not change the underlying odds of the draw game. As with any lottery product, buying a ticket does not guarantee a return, and the announced jackpot is a prize pool rather than a prediction that someone will win in a particular week.
dek: The $5 game asks players to select eight team logos, with weekly drawings beginning September 13 and a rolling jackpot starting at $1 million.
headline: Rhode Island launches NFL-themed Powerball Xs & Os game
